It's odd to see so many telling others NOT to buy this product because of their personal experience. I got what I deserved because you can't do that and expect a prize. Anyway, I now use this AM & PM, and let me tell you: it's been the missing link to my routine. My skin has never been more vibrant and supple, and my pores are now clear and appear smaller. My skin texture went from orange peel to newborn baby's rear end in two weeks with zero irritation. So, moral of this review is try these products for yourself to see what your skin can tolerate. Do start slowly, perhaps use once per day, and avoid other exfoliating ingredients initially. You can add one back in once your skin acclimates to the SA. I now can use retinol after this at night, vitamin C after this in the morning and I have DRY, SENSITIVE skin. So, success is possible.
